pf2e-consumables-tracker.EmptyState: No consumables found for the current filters.

IgnoreContainerItems.Name: Hide Items in Containers
IgnoreContainerItems.Hint: When enabled, consumables currently stored inside a container (backpack, bag of holding, etc.) are hidden from the tracker. Only items in the character's main inventory are shown.

RestrictPlayerView.Name: Restrict Player View
RestrictPlayerView.Hint: When enabled, non-GM players can only view the whole party or their own character(s) in the tracker - they cannot select another specific player's characters.

BlacklistMenu.Name: Consumables Blacklist
BlacklistMenu.Label: Configure Blacklist
BlacklistMenu.Hint: Choose specific consumables (by name or id) to always hide from the tracker.

ShareCombatAllies.Name: Show players allied NPC consumables in combat
ShareCombatAllies.Hint: Shares token names and identified item names, quantities and other displayed details with all players even if they cannot access the NPC sheet. Only visible friendly NPC combatants in the active combat are included. Off by default; hidden tokens and combatants are excluded.

ConfirmUse.Name: Confirm before using a consumable
ConfirmUse.Hint: Ask for confirmation before the tracker's Use button or a delivery message spends a consumable. Personal setting.

OpenTracker.Name: Open Consumables Tracker
OpenTracker.Hint: Opens the Party Consumables Tracker panel. Unbound by default - assign a key in Configure Controls.

Blacklist.Hint: Enter one item name or item ID per line. Matching is case-insensitive. Any consumable matching a line below will be hidden from the tracker for everyone.
Blacklist.KnownNamesHint: Click a name to add it to the list above.

pf2e-consumables-tracker.NoGM: An active GM must be online to request an item.
pf2e-consumables-tracker.NoOwner: No player owners of this character are online.
pf2e-consumables-tracker.RequestInvalid: The request is stale or unavailable; check item, permissions and status.
pf2e-consumables-tracker.RequestSent: Request whispered to the owner and GM.
pf2e-consumables-tracker.RequestError: Request action failed. See console for details.

pf2e-consumables-tracker.ApprovedSent: Approval sent to the GM. The item has not yet been transferred.

pf2e-consumables-tracker.ActiveGMOnly: Only the active GM may execute transfers.
pf2e-consumables-tracker.UnsupportedTransfer: This system version does not support the system transfer API.
pf2e-consumables-tracker.TransferFailed: Transfer may be partial. Inspect and repair both inventories; this request is locked.

pf2e-consumables-tracker.UseUnavailable: This item cannot be used from here (you must own it, and it must be a consumable with a system use action). Open its sheet instead.
